experimental_method: Dynamic moisture-generation bench (gas saturated in two temperature-controlled condensers at set pressure, continuous flow); water content of the generated wet gas by Karl Fischer titration at atmospheric pressure, dew point temperature at line pressure by a chilled-mirror instrument.
uncertainties_stated: Dew temperature better than 0.4 K; pressure transmitter maximum error 0.2% of calibrated range; Karl Fischer titrator with wet gas meter 0.2%; Table 1 gives repeatability/reproducibility of water content (test A Karl Fischer 59.26e-6 kg/m3, repeatability 0.73, reproducibility 1.68; test B dew point generation at 263.15 K and 60 bar 43.08, 3.64, 8.90).
quality_remarks: Water mole fraction y is calculated by the authors from the Karl Fischer water content, so the printed y is derived from a measurement. Dew points compared with Bogoya et al. and Kosyakov et al. (nitrogen+water): differences 0.15 to 2 K and up to 5 K (printed as '28' and '58' in the text layer; the degree sign was lost). Propane+water measured only at 1.01-4.99 bar because of propane vapour pressure. Temperature scale not stated; no statement whether condensed phase is water or ice below 273.15 K.
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer clean; script-parsed T,P pairs, all cells compared with 200 dpi page images and no discrepancy found.
